instruction: Please create a user named "tempuser" and set the account to expire on 2025-12-31.

result.command: USERNAME="tempuser"; if ! id "$USERNAME" &>/dev/null; then echo 'Check failed: user does not exist'; exit 1; fi; EXPIRY=$(chage -l "$USERNAME" | grep 'Account expires' | awk -F': ' '{print $2}'); if [[ "$EXPIRY" == "never" ]]; then echo 'Check failed: account expiry not set'; exit 1; fi; if [[ "$EXPIRY" =~ "Dec 31, 2025"|"2025-12-31" ]]; then echo 'User tempuser exists with account expiry set to Dec 31 2025'; else echo "Check failed: wrong expiry date: $EXPIRY"; fi

include: User tempuser exists with account expiry set to Dec 31 2025
